_comment: Copy to <data dir>/known_issues.json (data/known_issues.json by default), or point
TPM_KNOWLEDGE_FILE at it. Loaded on the next tool call after it changes; entries that are
rejected are listed with the reason by check_log_sources.
Required per issue: id, title, pattern (a regular expression, case-insensitive).
Optional: impact (high|medium|low|none - none means noise), category, explanation,
source. Reusing a built-in id replaces that built-in issue.

known_issues.title: Proxy rejects client downloads (ticket OPS-4711)
known_issues.explanation: The corporate proxy asks TPM clients to authenticate, which they cannot do, so content downloads fail.
known_issues.remediation: Allow *.adaptiva.cloud and the CDN host through the proxy without authentication or inspection.

known_issues.title: Receipt cleanup chatter we have agreed to ignore
known_issues.pattern: Could not find serverContentMetadataObject, while deleting receipts

known_issues.title: Patching skipped outside the change window
known_issues.explanation: Expected on servers whose change window is one hour a week; the deployment retries in the next window.
known_issues.remediation: Only investigate if the same device skips several windows in a row.

reboot_required.true: The device must reboot to finish the install
